user.title: Sign in to Umeå Energi
user.description: Choose your customer type and how to sign in to Mina sidor.

email.title: Sign in with email
email.description: Enter your Mina sidor email and password. Umeå Energi then emails you a one-time login code.

email_code.title: Enter login code
email_code.description: Enter the code that was sent to {username}.

bankid_failed.title: BankID login failed
bankid_failed.description: The BankID login was cancelled, expired or failed. Submit to try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Umeå Energi session has expired. Sign in again to continue fetching consumption.

error.invalid_code: The login code was not accepted.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Umeå Energi.
